post.description: Creates a new teacher instance (tenant) with a brand, teacher profile, and returns JWT tokens. The subdomain is auto-generated from the teacher name if not provided. The instance starts on the FREE tier by default.
Authenticates a teacher using their email and password. Returns access and refresh JWT tokens upon successful authentication.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token and refresh token pair. Refresh tokens are valid for 30 days.

get.description: Returns the authenticated teacher's profile including instance tier, subdomain, and account metadata. Requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header.

post.description: Allows a student to join a group and get a JWT. If the code is a valid group ID and the group is in OPEN mode, the student joins directly. If the code is an invitation code (from a CLOSED group), the student joins via invitation. If the student email already exists, a new JWT is returned (idempotent re-auth). Returns access and refresh JWT tokens for student API access.

400.description: Group is not open for registration

404.description: Invalid invitation code or group ID

post.summary: Student signup via invitation code or open group

post.description: Creates a group scoped to the authenticated teacher's instance. Enforces tier limits: FREE plan allows only 1 group. Group names must be unique within the instance.

get.description: Returns all groups for the authenticated teacher's instance, including active/inactive student counts and current tier limits.
Returns a single group with student counts.

patch.description: Updates group name, description, or registration mode. Group names must remain unique within the instance.

delete.description: Deletes a group and all its associated data (students, courses, sessions, quizzes, assignments, chat messages). This action is irreversible.

post.description: Generates a new unique invitation code for the group. When registration mode is CLOSED, students can only join using this code. Generating a new code invalidates the previous one.

delete.description: Removes the invitation code from the group, preventing new students from joining via invitation link.

post.description: Adds a student to a group within the teacher's instance. If the instance has reached its tier student limit, the student is created as INACTIVE. Email is unique within the instance.

409.description: Email already exists in this instance

get.description: Returns all students in the teacher's instance. Optionally filter by groupId. Includes active/inactive counts and tier student limit.
Downloads all students (optionally filtered by group) as a CSV file. Columns: name, email, phone, status, groupId, createdAt.

post.description: Imports multiple students into a group in one request. Students beyond the tier limit are created as INACTIVE. Duplicate emails within the instance are skipped.

Allows a student to join a group using an invitation code. No authentication required — this is a public endpoint. The group must be in CLOSED registration mode. Students beyond the tier limit are created as INACTIVE.

400.description: Group is not in CLOSED mode

get.description: Returns a single student's details.

patch.description: Updates student name, email, phone, status, or group assignment. Email must remain unique within the instance. Can move a student to a different group within the same instance.

404.description: Student or target group not found

delete.description: Removes a student and all associated data (enrollments, quiz attempts, assignment submissions, payments). This action is irreversible.

post.description: Creates a course within a group. All sessions, quizzes, assignments, and enrollments will be scoped to this course. Courses are tenant-isolated — only visible within the teacher's instance.

get.description: Returns all courses for the authenticated teacher's instance. Optionally filter by groupId to get courses in a specific group. Includes enrolled student counts.
Returns a single course with its details and enrolled student count. Includes sessions, quizzes, and assignments counts.

patch.description: Updates course title, description, or price. Only fields provided in the request body will be updated.

delete.description: Deletes a course and all its associated data (sessions, quizzes, quiz questions, assignments, submissions, enrollments, payments). This action is irreversible.

post.description: Enrolls one or more students in a course. Students must belong to the same group as the course. Duplicate enrollments are silently ignored (idempotent).

400.description: Some students not found or not in the same group

get.description: Returns all students enrolled in a course. Includes student name, email, and enrollment date.

delete.description: Removes a student's enrollment from a course. Does not delete the student or course — only the enrollment link.

post.description: Creates a session within a course. Supports both LOCAL (in-person) and ONLINE (virtual) session types. For LOCAL sessions, provide a location. For ONLINE sessions, provide platform and meetingUrl. Session creation triggers a notification event (handled by the notification system).

get.description: Returns all sessions for the authenticated teacher's instance. Optionally filter by courseId, date range (from/to). Sessions are sorted by start time ascending.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter sessions starting from this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter sessions starting until this date (ISO 8601)

get.description: Returns a single session with full details including type-specific fields (location for LOCAL, platform/meetingUrl for ONLINE).

patch.description: Updates session details including title, time, type, and type-specific fields. Can change a session from LOCAL to ONLINE or vice versa. Only fields provided in the request body will be updated.

delete.description: Deletes a session. This action is irreversible. Does not delete the associated course or any other data.

get.description: Returns the brand configuration (colors, font, logo, white-label status) for the current instance.

patch.description: Updates brand colors, font family, custom domain, or white-label toggle. White-label requires a paid tier.

403.description: White-label not available on Free tier

post.description: Uploads a logo image to MinIO storage and updates the brand logo URL.

delete.description: Deletes the logo from MinIO storage and clears the logo URL.

get.description: Returns public brand settings (logo, colors, font) for anonymous visitors. Used to render the teacher's public-facing site.
get.summary: Get public brand info by subdomain

post.description: Creates a quiz within a course. Quiz totalMarks should equal the sum of all question marks. Quizzes are tenant-isolated — only visible within the teacher's instance.

get.description: Returns all quizzes for the authenticated teacher's instance. Optionally filter by courseId. Includes question counts for each quiz.
Returns a single quiz with all its questions. Includes question details, types, options, and correct answers.

patch.description: Updates quiz title, description, or total marks. Only fields provided in the request body will be updated.

delete.description: Deletes a quiz and all its associated questions and attempts. This action is irreversible.

post.description: Adds a new question to an existing quiz. Supports MCQ (multiple choice) and THEORY (written answer) types. For MCQ, provide options array and correctAnswer for auto-grading. For THEORY, no correctAnswer is needed (teacher grades manually).
post.summary: Add a question to a quiz

get.description: Returns all questions for a quiz. Includes options, correct answers, and marks for each question.
get.summary: List all questions in a quiz

patch.description: Updates a question's text, type, options, correct answer, or marks. Only fields provided in the request body will be updated.

delete.description: Removes a question from a quiz. This action is irreversible and may affect existing quiz attempts.

post.description: Submits a student's answers for a quiz. MCQ questions are auto-graded immediately — score is calculated. THEORY questions are left ungraded (teacher must grade manually). Each student can only submit once per quiz (unique constraint). The answers array must contain one entry per question in the quiz.

409.description: Student has already submitted this quiz

get.description: Returns all student attempts for a quiz. Shows each student's score, answers, and submission time. Use this to review student performance on a quiz.
get.summary: List all attempts for a quiz

get.description: Returns a single student's attempt for a quiz with full details. Shows each answer, whether it was correct (MCQ), and marks earned.

post.description: Creates an assignment within a course. Students can submit text and/or file attachments. An optional due date can be set for submission deadline.

get.description: Returns all assignments for the authenticated teacher's instance. Optionally filter by courseId.
Returns a single assignment with full details including due date and description.

patch.description: Updates assignment title, description, or due date. Only fields provided in the request body will be updated.

delete.description: Deletes an assignment and all associated submissions. This action is irreversible.

post.description: Submits a student's work for an assignment. Supports both text content and file upload. File is uploaded to MinIO storage and a URL is stored with the submission. Each student can only submit once per assignment (use PATCH to update).

409.description: Already submitted — use PATCH to resubmit

get.description: Returns all student submissions for an assignment. Shows student ID, content, file URL, grade, and feedback. Use this to review and grade student work.
get.summary: List all submissions for an assignment

get.description: Returns a single student's submission for an assignment. Shows content, file URL, grade, and feedback.

patch.description: Grades a student's submission with a score and optional feedback. Grade should be on the same scale as the assignment (e.g., out of 20). Feedback is visible to the student.

get.description: Returns a complete gradebook for a course. Shows all enrolled students with their quiz scores, assignment grades, and overall percentage. Quiz scores are auto-graded (MCQ) or null (theory pending). Assignment grades are null until the teacher grades them.
Returns an aggregated gradebook for an entire group. Combines quiz and assignment results across all courses in the group. Shows each student's performance across all courses.
Returns a single student's performance across all courses. Shows all quiz attempts with scores and all assignment submissions with grades. Includes overall percentage across all graded items.

post.summary: Connect WhatsApp number (QR or pairing code)

get.summary: Get current QR code data URL
